mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the arm to the brain and spinal cord was most worthwhile because it showed how sensory input and motor output relate during movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: The individual pathway fittings felt repetitive: each confirmed a slot was filled without adding much explanation until the last one.

surprise.text: The explanation that muscle spindles contribute to our sense of limb position added a useful connection beyond simply detecting stretch.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the named slots gave the fittings a purpose, although the offered compatible choices made them predictable.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the responsive arm connects to the rest of the body. The links between cellular activity and movement are interesting, though I hope later combinations offer more explanation and fewer repetitive fittings.
